data.name: ConstructorConstraintDescription
data.value: Positional aggregate, unit, and feature records must satisfy the new() constraint. Features are recognized through their UseCase base or Creational<>, Transitional<>, or NonMutational attributes. The type must be non-abstract and have a public parameterless constructor. If it has required members, that constructor must be annotated with SetsRequiredMembers.

data.name: ConstructorConstraintMessage
data.value: Aggregate or feature type `{0}` must satisfy the new() constraint: it must be non-abstract and have a public parameterless constructor that satisfies any required members

data.name: ConstructorConstraintTitle
data.value: Aggregate or Feature Constructor Constraint Not Satisfied
